# Creative Control Is Not Economic Control — motion and channel evidence manifest

Version 2.0 · RN Collins · 7 September 2026

## Reels / TikTok / Shorts
### 0–8s — OBJ-loc-gtfy-00717
Voiceover: One frame holds a named designer, a model, a photographer, a collection, and an institutional record—separate roles that public shorthand often compresses.

### 8–16s — CO02-DIAGRAM-1
Voiceover: 01 · CREATIVE — What can be approved?. Define the domain: collection, silhouette, casting, campaign, store environment, brand aesthetic, collaborator, or final release. “Creative control” without subject, threshold, and override mechanism is a slogan, not an operational record.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 16–24s — CO02-DIAGRAM-2
Voiceover: 02 · GOVERNANCE — Who directs the company?. For a Delaware corporation, start with the certificate, bylaws, board composition, delegated authority, and §141. Then inspect committees, reserved matters, stockholder rights, and actual agreements rather than assuming the creative title controls the enterprise.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 24–32s — CO02-DIAGRAM-3
Voiceover: 03 · ECONOMICS — Who receives value and bears risk?. Equity ownership, voting rights, salary, royalty, bonus, license income, liquidation preference, debt covenants, and sale proceeds are distinct economic or control mechanisms. Public proxy and annual-report disclosures can demonstrate some layers while leaving private arrangements unknown.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 32–40s — CO02-DIAGRAM-4
Voiceover: 04 · FAILURE TEST — What happens after conflict or departure?. Map removal, termination, good-reason provisions, cure periods, post-term use, transition duties, archive access, approval survival, and dispute procedure. Authority that exists only while a title is held may disappear differently from voting power or asset ownership.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
